Ben / Mina —

Thanks for pulling this. A few legal points to add to the matrix before we send to Acme: 
- For the CDN: we need to call out whether we move personal data outside the EEA and, if so, whether SCCs are in place between Redwood and the CDN (and between CDN and its downstream providers). - For analytics: if only aggregated telemetry is exported, note that. If raw request metadata is exported, we should confirm legal basis and SCCs.
- UK customers: include whether we rely on UK IDTA vs SCCs (two different declarations).
- Add a "transfer_risk" column with short free text: (low/medium/high) and a one‑line mitigation. Procurement customers like Acme often use that to triage.

Also — Acme asked about support tools with log access. Confirm whether support teams have direct access to PII in logs; if so we must enumerate the controls (role‑based access, session recording off, retention).

I’ll draft a short cover note referencing the DPA clause numbers and the SOC2 controls that support our attestations.
